body:
PulseSMP

PulseSMP introduces a unique ability-based gameplay system to your server through powerful items known as Pulses. Each Pulse grants distinct abilities that enhance combat, movement, and overall player interaction, creating a more dynamic and engaging SMP experience.

Designed with flexibility and performance in mind, PulseSMP integrates seamlessly into survival gameplay while adding depth through cooldown-based abilities and progression systems.

Features
Pulse Ability System
Obtain and use custom Pulse items, each with its own unique abilities and effects.
Random Spin Mechanic
Acquire Pulses through a built-in spin system for a balanced and unpredictable experience.
Cooldown Management
Abilities are balanced with cooldowns to ensure fair gameplay.
Custom Commands
Includes a full set of commands for managing Pulses, giving items, viewing information, and more.
Expandable System
Structured to support additional Pulses, abilities, and features over time.
Gameplay

Players can obtain Pulses and use their abilities strategically in combat and exploration. The system encourages diverse playstyles while maintaining balance through cooldowns and restrictions.

Commands
/pulse spin – Obtain a random Pulse
/pulse give – Give a Pulse to a player
/pulse list – View all available Pulses
/pulse info – Get information about a Pulse
/pulse cooldown – Manage ability cooldowns
/pulse reload – Reload plugin configuration
Permissions
pulsesmp.use – Basic usage
pulsesmp.admin – Full administrative access
